mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, prompting central bank policy easing that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in a month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 100 indicates supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through margin compression and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 100 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% for a quarter but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal labor market contraction coupled with monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market contraction with monetary tightening
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS rises simultaneously but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,000,000 units for two consecutive months indicates housing market downturn, reducing consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST remains below 1,000,000 for two consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
